# TRL-VAR-0012: Logging-command variable mutation is not permitted

- Severity: warning
- Exit class: none
- Area: VAR
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active
- Fidelity: exact

## Remediation

Add the variable to target.settableVariables or remove the logging command.

## Example

```json
{"code": "TRL-VAR-0012", "severity": "warning", "params": {"name": "<name>"}}
```
